copilotInstructions.content:
## Azure DevOps Integration

This project uses Azure DevOps for work tracking and CI/CD.

- **Organization**: {{ADO_ORG}}
- **Project**: {{ADO_PROJECT}}

When working on features:
1. Reference work item IDs in commits using AB#12345 format
2. Link PRs to work items
3. Check pipeline status before merging

The Azure DevOps MCP server is available. Always check if there's a relevant tool before searching the web.
